name: Suri Kell
bio: Kell signed after one live-fire circuit and asked for another. The instructors disagreed about whether that was courage.

personality.label: Fearless spark
personality.description: Greets danger with infectious enthusiasm. Still learning that bravery includes backing away.

move: Keep up. Actually, I will keep up. Moving.
attack: Another live-fire circuit. Let us go.
guard: Holding. I can be patient. Watch.
hold_fire: All right, all right. Fingers off.
investigate: I will find out! Carefully. Heard you.
heavy_fire: Okay, that is a lot of fire! Need help!
Still standing, but this would be a good time for cover.
